scope: Preserve project credential-reference drafts, discard pre-mutation state responses and cancel disposed Apps requests; correct first-install startup-gate order and dependencies

source.definition: Sorted tracked and nonignored untracked JS/Python/shell/config/HTML/CSS/Markdown sources; path + NUL + LF-normalized UTF-8 + NUL. Deployment evidence subdirectories excluded.

limitations: Local SDK/Native/Chromium fixtures do not prove a fully deployed shop or live iPhone behavior
The infrastructure result does not remove known application acceptance failures
First-install documentation and syntax checks are not an empty-host installation proof
Private raw logs and application data are not published
